about: Head-to-head tasks. Each runs in a fresh copy of fixture/. A check is either hidden tests (copied in after the run, never shown to the model) or a pattern the final answer must match. Add your own tasks in the same shape; real tasks from your work make the results far more meaningful.

tasks.prompt: Which file in this project defines the function applyDiscount? Reply with exactly one line: PATH=<path relative to the project root>.
formatPrice in src/format.js gives wrong output for negative prices and for fractional cents. Fix it so it matches its doc comment.
Implement slugify in src/slug.js so it does exactly what its doc comment says, and add tests for it in test/.
Implement groupBy in src/collections.js as its doc comment describes.
Customers report being charged too little when they enter two promotion codes on one order. Find the cause in the cart code and fix it, keeping the documented behaviour.
Implement freeSlots in src/schedule.js. Read its doc comment carefully: the input can be messy, and the edge cases matter. Add tests that cover them.

Read data/orders.txt and write data/orders.json: a JSON array of objects {id (number), customer (string), total (number)} for every valid line, in file order. Skip comments, blank lines, malformed lines, lines whose total is not a number, and lines with an empty customer. Trim spaces around keys and values.
Review src/refund.js for bugs. Do not change any file. Reply with exactly one line: LINE=<line number of the most serious bug>, then one sentence saying what is wrong.
